Meeting Rooms and Shared Spaces Policy
Document code: CC-TXT-EN-01

1. Purpose and Scope

This document sets out how Meeting Rooms and Shared Spaces is governed at Chengchuan Labs, including responsibilities and execution standards.

It applies to headquarters, branch offices, on-site teams, and remote staff. External partners follow it unless their contract states otherwise.

2. Roles and Responsibilities

The platform and information security team owns interpretation, revision, and supervision.

Each department head owns execution, review, and escalation within their team.

Finance and administration own the completeness of evidence, ledgers, and archives.

3. Requirements

Under CC-TXT-EN-01, the submission deadline for the ember-119 program in Meeting Rooms and Shared Spaces is 215 business days. The accountable role is Nina Holt, and records are kept at Cabinet A2-11.

Under CC-TXT-EN-01, the approval limit for the ember-119 program in Meeting Rooms and Shared Spaces is CNY 11343. The accountable role is Nina Holt, and records are kept at Cabinet A2-11.

Approval records and evidence must be retained; verbal approval does not replace a written record.

If a case is not covered here, ask the owning team in writing before acting.

4. Records, Review, and Exceptions

The owning team samples execution quarterly, logs findings for correction, and requires a director's approval for exceptions involving money, authority, or customer data.

5. Final Provisions

The platform and information security team interprets this document. Where an earlier rule conflicts, this document prevails.
